name: Underwater sound river Maas 03 190616_0035 0036.wav
description: Underwater sound of Dutch river (hydroponic). A boat has just sailed along this jetty. My hydrophones hang just below the water surface. What do you hear; 1] moving the jetty along the posts caused by a large ship propeller. 2] waves and bubbles. 3] animals that scrape alga from stones. I do not know which animals but there are a few options such as the black crab, American crayfish, European crayfish and fish. Who knows may say. 4] moving small pebble stones by USO’s . 5] and more unidentified noises. 6] small fish (2-3 cm) hitting the hydrophones. Sounds as hard bumps. 7] me coughing There is no one around and no water birds are swimming. Anyone who still thinks you don't hear much underwater is mistaken. Date/time: June 16th Sunday 2019, start 7.19 pm Weather: calm Location; River Maas along Bokhovense Maasdijk, Noord-Brabant, Netherlands (Holland), Europe GPS 51.73572 5.24014 Gear chain: two Aquarian Audio Hydrophones H2a XLR 3m > Sound Devices 302 >Tascam dr-100 Mk2.
